es: Surf House es un proyecto residencial en Surfside, en 8995 Collins Ave, Surfside, FL 33154. Contempla 17 residencias en 11 pisos, de 2 – 5 habitaciones y de 2,262 – 7,780 sq ft.
Equipo: arquitectura de Kobi Karp Architecture / Jerome Engelking; desarrollo de Fort Partners. Entrega estimada: 2026. Precios desde $8,500,000.
en: Surf House is a residential project in Surfside, at 8995 Collins Ave, Surfside, FL 33154. It comprises 17 residences over 11 floors, with 2 – 5 bedrooms and of 2,262 – 7,780 sq ft.
Team: architecture by Kobi Karp Architecture / Jerome Engelking; developed by Fort Partners. Estimated delivery: 2026. Prices from $8,500,000.
